# TECHNAVIA

> TECHNAVIA (technaviatechnology.com) is a B2B web engineering, Technical SEO, LLM Visibility (AEO/GEO), and Custom AI Automation studio based in Surat, Gujarat, India serving global clients — distinct from Technavio market research.

We engineer sub-second Next.js websites built to rank on Google, get cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity, and automate B2B lead pipelines. Contact: inquiry@technaviatechnology.com.

## Core Services

- [Web Development + Technical SEO](https://technaviatechnology.com/services/web-development-seo): Next.js App Router engineering with 100/100 Core Web Vitals, sub-400ms LCP, and connected JSON-LD entity graphs.
- [LLM Visibility (AEO / GEO)](https://technaviatechnology.com/services/llm-visibility): Entity graph optimization and information-gain content architecture so AI answer engines cite and recommend your brand.
- [Custom AI Automations](https://technaviatechnology.com/services/ai-automations): Event-driven n8n, Python, and CRM workflows that qualify and route inbound leads in under 60 seconds.

## Proof Builds & Case Studies

- [Seravolve](https://technaviatechnology.com/results/seravolve): Production B2B web and technical SEO engineering build.
- [TG media](https://technaviatechnology.com/results/tg-media): High-speed digital platform and conversion architecture.
- [COSMO SOLOR](https://technaviatechnology.com/results/cosmo-solor): Custom web system engineered for search visibility and lead capture.

## Technical Blueprints

- [How to Rank in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini](https://technaviatechnology.com/blogs/ranking-in-chatgpt-perplexity): Structuring entity graphs and information-gain content for AI search.
- [Why Sub-400ms LCP Is the Highest-ROI Technical SEO Lever](https://technaviatechnology.com/blogs/core-web-vitals-100-guide): Server-rendered architecture for crawl budget and ranking velocity.
- [Automating B2B Lead Pipelines](https://technaviatechnology.com/blogs/automating-b2b-lead-pipeline): Patterns for AI lead qualification and instant calendar sync.
- [Entity Graph Optimization for LLM Crawlers](https://technaviatechnology.com/blogs/entity-graph-optimization-geo): Nested Schema.org graphs for deterministic AI entity retrieval.
- [Next.js 15 Server Components for SEO](https://technaviatechnology.com/blogs/nextjs-15-server-components-seo): Eliminating client hydration bloat for faster indexing.
- [Autonomous CRM Sync Agents](https://technaviatechnology.com/blogs/autonomous-crm-sync-agents): Fault-tolerant workflows with n8n and Supabase.
